entries.source_description: Enables additional camera recoil.
entries.translation_description: 추가 카메라 반동 여부를 설정합니다.

entries.source_description: Multiplier for additional recoil when using ironsights.
entries.translation_display_name: 기계식 조준기 사용 시 추가 반동 배율
entries.translation_description: 기계식 조준기로 조준할 때 추가 반동에 적용할 배율입니다.

entries.source_description: Camera recoil return speed.
entries.translation_description: 카메라 반동이 원래 방향으로 돌아오는 속도입니다.

entries.source_description: Enables an alternate version of real recoil that uses a spring based system and has auto-compensation.

entries.translation_description: 느린 스프링 활성화 여부를 설정합니다.

entries.source_description: Enables class specific real recoil multipliers. Recommended to keep enabled since pistols have insane recoil values.
entries.translation_description: 무기 종류별 반동 배율 활성화 여부를 설정합니다.

entries.source_description: Enables weapon sway when moving.
